overview:
This Datadog-[Scylla][1] integration collects a majority of the exposed metrics by default, with the ability to customize additional groups based on specific user needs.

Scylla is an open-source NoSQL data store that can act as "a drop-in Apache Cassandra alternative." It has rearchitected the Cassandra model tuned for modern hardware, reducing the size of required clusters while improving theoretical throughput and performance.

**Minimum Agent version:** 7.17.2

[1]: https://scylladb.com
setup:
Follow the instructions below to install and configure this check for an Agent running on a host.

### Installation

The Scylla check is included in the [Datadog Agent][2] package. No additional installation is needed on your server.

### Configuration

1. Edit the `scylla.d/conf.yaml` file, in the `conf.d/` folder at the root of your Agent's configuration directory to start collecting your scylla performance data. See the [sample scylla.d/conf.yaml][3] for all available configuration options. If you previously implemented this integration, see the [legacy example][11].

2. [Restart the Agent][4].

##### Log collection

Scylla has different modes of outputting logs depending on the environment it's running in. See the [Scylla documentation][5] for more specifics on how the application generates logs.

1. Collecting logs is disabled by default in the Datadog Agent, enable it in your `datadog.yaml` file:

      ```yaml
       logs_enabled: true
     ```

2. Uncomment and edit the logs configuration block in your `scylla.d/conf.yaml` file. Change the `type`, `path`, and `service` parameter values based on your environment. See the [sample scylla.d/conf.yaml][3] for all available configuration options.

      ```yaml
       logs:
         - type: file
           path: <LOG_FILE_PATH>
           source: scylla
           service: <SERVICE_NAME>
           #To handle multi line that starts with yyyy-mm-dd use the following pattern
           #log_processing_rules:
           #  - type: multi_line
           #    pattern: \d{4}\-(0?[1-9]|1[012])\-(0?[1-9]|[12][0-9]|3[01])
           #    name: new_log_start_with_date
     ```

3. [Restart the Agent][4].

To enable logs for Kubernetes environments, see [Kubernetes Log Collection][6].

### Validation

[Run the Agent's status subcommand][7] and look for `scylla` under the Checks section.

metrics.name: scylla.commitlog.active_allocations
metrics.description: Current number of active allocations.

metrics.name: scylla.commitlog.alloc
metrics.description: Counts a number of times a new mutation has been added to a segment. Divide bytes_written by this value to get the average number of bytes per mutation written to the disk.

metrics.name: scylla.commitlog.allocating_segments
metrics.description: Holds the number of not closed segments that still have some free space. This value should not get too high.

metrics.name: scylla.commitlog.blocked_on_new_segment
metrics.description: Number of allocations blocked on acquiring new segment.

metrics.name: scylla.commitlog.bytes_flush_requested
metrics.description: Counts number of bytes requested to be flushed (persisted).

metrics.name: scylla.commitlog.bytes_released
metrics.description: Counts number of bytes released from disk. (Deleted/recycled)

metrics.name: scylla.commitlog.bytes_written
metrics.description: Counts a number of bytes written to the disk. Divide this value by "alloc" to get the average number of bytes per mutation written to the disk.

metrics.name: scylla.commitlog.cycle
metrics.description: Counts a number of commitlog write cycles - when the data is written from the internal memory buffer to the disk.

metrics.name: scylla.commitlog.disk_active_bytes
metrics.description: Holds size of disk space in bytes used for data so far. A too high value indicates that we have some bottleneck in the writing to sstables path.

metrics.name: scylla.commitlog.disk_slack_end_bytes
metrics.description: Holds size of disk space in bytes unused because of segment switching (end slack). A too high value indicates that we do not write enough data to each segment.

metrics.name: scylla.commitlog.disk_total_bytes
metrics.description: Holds a size of disk space in bytes used for data so far. A too high value indicates that we have some bottleneck in the writing to sstables path.

metrics.name: scylla.commitlog.flush
metrics.description: Counts a number of times the flush() method was called for a file.

metrics.name: scylla.commitlog.flush_limit_exceeded
metrics.description: Counts a number of times a flush limit was exceeded. A non-zero value indicates that there are too many pending flush operations (see pending_flushes) and some of them will be blocked till the total amount of pending flush operations drops below 5.

metrics.name: scylla.commitlog.memory_buffer_bytes
metrics.description: Holds the total number of bytes in internal memory buffers.

metrics.name: scylla.commitlog.pending_allocations
metrics.description: Holds a number of currently pending allocations. A non-zero value indicates that we have a bottleneck in the disk write flow.

metrics.name: scylla.commitlog.pending_flushes
metrics.description: Holds a number of currently pending flushes. See the related flush_limit_exceeded metric.

metrics.name: scylla.commitlog.requests_blocked_memory
metrics.description: Counts a number of requests blocked due to memory pressure. A non-zero value indicates that the commitlog memory quota is not enough to serve the required amount of requests.

metrics.name: scylla.commitlog.segments
metrics.description: Holds the current number of segments.

metrics.name: scylla.commitlog.slack
metrics.description: Counts a number of unused bytes written to the disk due to disk segment alignment.

metrics.name: scylla.commitlog.unused_segments
metrics.description: Holds the current number of unused segments. A non-zero value indicates that the disk write path became temporary slow.

metrics.name: scylla.compaction.manager_backlog
metrics.description: Holds the sum of compaction backlog for all tables in the system.

metrics.name: scylla.compaction_manager.compactions
metrics.description: Holds the number of currently active compactions.

metrics.name: scylla.compaction_manager.completed_compactions
metrics.description: Holds the number of completed compaction tasks.

metrics.name: scylla.compaction_manager.failed_compactions
metrics.description: Holds the number of failed compaction tasks.

metrics.name: scylla.compaction_manager.normalized_backlog
metrics.description: Holds the sum of normalized compaction backlog for all tables in the system. Backlog is normalized by dividing backlog by shard's available memory.

metrics.name: scylla.compaction_manager.pending_compactions
metrics.description: Holds the number of compaction tasks waiting for an opportunity to run.

metrics.name: scylla.compaction_manager.postponed_compactions
metrics.description: Holds the number of tables with postponed compaction.

metrics.name: scylla.compaction_manager.validation_errors
metrics.description: Holds the number of encountered validation errors.

metrics.name: scylla.cql.authorized_prepared_statements_cache_size
metrics.description: A number of entries in the authenticated prepared statements cache.

metrics.name: scylla.cql.batches
metrics.description: Counts a total number of CQL BATCH requests.

metrics.name: scylla.cql.batches_pure_logged
metrics.description: Counts a total number of LOGGED batches that were executed as LOGGED batches.

metrics.name: scylla.cql.batches_pure_unlogged
metrics.description: Counts a total number of UNLOGGED batches that were executed as UNLOGGED batches.

metrics.name: scylla.cql.batches_unlogged_from_logged
metrics.description: Counts a total number of LOGGED batches that were executed as UNLOGGED batches.

metrics.name: scylla.cql.deletes
metrics.description: Counts a total number of CQL DELETE requests.

metrics.name: scylla.cql.deletes_per_ks
metrics.description: Counts the number of CQL DELETE requests executed on particular keyspaces. Label `who' indicates where the reqs come from (clients or DB internals)

metrics.name: scylla.cql.filtered_read_requests
metrics.description: Counts a total number of CQL read requests that required ALLOW FILTERING. See filtered_rows_read_total to compare how many rows needed to be filtered.

metrics.name: scylla.cql.filtered_rows_dropped_total
metrics.description: Counts a number of rows read during CQL requests that required ALLOW FILTERING and dropped by the filter. Number similar to filtered_rows_read_total indicates that filtering is not accurate and might cause performance degradation.

metrics.name: scylla.cql.filtered_rows_matched_total
metrics.description: Counts a number of rows read during CQL requests that required ALLOW FILTERING and accepted by the filter. Number similar to filtered_rows_read_total indicates that filtering is accurate.

metrics.name: scylla.cql.filtered_rows_read_total
metrics.description: Counts a total number of rows read during CQL requests that required ALLOW FILTERING. See filtered_rows_matched_total and filtered_rows_dropped_total for information how accurate filtering queries are.

metrics.name: scylla.cql.inserts
metrics.description: Counts a total number of CQL INSERT requests.

metrics.name: scylla.cql.inserts_per_ks
metrics.description: Counts the number of CQL INSERT requests executed on particular keyspaces. Label `who' indicates where the reqs come from (clients or DB internals).

metrics.name: scylla.cql.prepared_cache_evictions
metrics.description: Counts a number of prepared statements cache entries evictions.

metrics.name: scylla.cql.prepared_cache_memory_footprint

metrics.name: scylla.cql.prepared_cache_size

metrics.name: scylla.cql.reads
metrics.description: Counts a total number of CQL read requests.

metrics.name: scylla.cql.reads_per_ks
metrics.description: Counts the number of CQL SELECT requests executed on particular keyspaces. Label `who' indicates where the reqs come from (clients or DB internals)

metrics.name: scylla.cql.reverse_queries
metrics.description: Counts number of CQL SELECT requests with ORDER BY DESC.

metrics.name: scylla.cql.rows_read
metrics.description: Counts a total number of rows read during CQL requests.

metrics.name: scylla.cql.secondary_index_creates
metrics.description: Counts a total number of CQL CREATE INDEX requests.

metrics.name: scylla.cql.secondary_index_drops
metrics.description: Counts a total number of CQL DROP INDEX requests.

metrics.name: scylla.cql.secondary_index_reads
metrics.description: Counts a total number of CQL read requests performed using secondary indexes.

metrics.name: scylla.cql.secondary_index_rows_read
metrics.description: Counts a total number of rows read during CQL requests performed using secondary indexes.

metrics.name: scylla.cql.select_allow_filtering
metrics.description: Counts the number of SELECT query executions with ALLOW FILTERING option.

metrics.name: scylla.cql.select_bypass_caches
metrics.description: Counts the number of SELECT query executions with BYPASS CACHE option.

metrics.name: scylla.cql.select_parallelized
metrics.description: Counts the number of parallelized aggregation SELECT query executions.

metrics.name: scylla.cql.select_partition_range_scan
metrics.description: Counts the number of SELECT query executions requiring partition range scan.

metrics.name: scylla.cql.select_partition_range_scan_no_bypass_cache
metrics.description: Counts the number of SELECT query executions requiring partition range scan without BYPASS CACHE option.

metrics.name: scylla.cql.statements_in_batches
metrics.description: Counts a total number of sub-statements in CQL BATCH requests.

metrics.name: scylla.cql.unpaged_select_queries
metrics.description: Counts number of unpaged CQL SELECT requests.

metrics.name: scylla.cql.unpaged_select_queries_per_ks
metrics.description: Counts the number of unpaged CQL SELECT requests against particular keyspaces.

metrics.name: scylla.cql.unprivileged_entries_evictions_on_size
metrics.description: Counts a number of evictions of prepared statements from the prepared statements cache after they have been used only once. An increasing counter suggests the user may be preparing a different statement for each request instead of reusing the same prepared statement with parameters.

metrics.name: scylla.cql.updates
metrics.description: Counts a total number of CQL UPDATE requests.

metrics.name: scylla.cql.updates_per_ks
metrics.description: Counts the number of CQL UPDATE requests executed on particular keyspaces. Label `who' indicates where the reqs come from (clients or DB internals)

metrics.name: scylla.cql.user_prepared_auth_cache_footprint
metrics.description: Size (in bytes) of the authenticated prepared statements cache.

metrics.name: scylla.database.active_reads
metrics.description: Holds the number of currently active read operations.

metrics.name: scylla.database.active_reads_memory_consumption
metrics.description: Holds the amount of memory consumed by currently active read operations. If this value gets close to 2474639 we are likely to start dropping new read requests. In that case sstable_read_queue_overloads is going to get a non-zero value.

metrics.name: scylla.database.clustering_filter_count
metrics.description: Counts bloom filter invocations.

metrics.name: scylla.database.clustering_filter_fast_path_count
metrics.description: Counts number of times bloom filtering short cut to include all sstables when only one full range was specified.

metrics.name: scylla.database.clustering_filter_sstables_checked
metrics.description: Counts sstables checked after applying the bloom filter. High value indicates that bloom filter is not very efficient.

metrics.name: scylla.database.clustering_filter_surviving_sstables
metrics.description: Counts sstables that survived the clustering key filtering. High value indicates that bloom filter is not very efficient and still have to access a lot of sstables to get data.

metrics.name: scylla.database.counter_cell_lock_acquisition
metrics.description: The number of acquired counter cell locks.

metrics.name: scylla.database.counter_cell_lock_pending
metrics.description: The number of counter updates waiting for a lock.

metrics.name: scylla.database.disk_reads
metrics.description: Holds the number of currently active disk read operations.

metrics.name: scylla.database.dropped_view_updates
metrics.description: Counts the number of view updates that have been dropped due to cluster overload.

metrics.name: scylla.database.large_partition_exceeding_threshold
metrics.description: Number of large partitions exceeding compaction_large_partition_warning_threshold_mb. Large partitions have performance impact and should be avoided; check the documentation for details.

metrics.name: scylla.database.multishard_query_failed_reader_saves
metrics.description: The number of times the saving of a shard reader failed.

metrics.name: scylla.database.multishard_query_failed_reader_stops
metrics.description: The number of times the stopping of a shard reader failed.

metrics.name: scylla.database.multishard_query_unpopped_bytes
metrics.description: The total number of bytes that were extracted from the shard reader but were unconsumed by the query and moved back into the reader.

metrics.name: scylla.database.multishard_query_unpopped_fragments
metrics.description: The total number of fragments that were extracted from the shard reader but were unconsumed by the query and moved back into the reader.

metrics.name: scylla.database.paused_reads
metrics.description: The number of currently active reads that are temporarily paused.

metrics.name: scylla.database.paused_reads_permit_based_evictions
metrics.description: The number of paused reads evicted to free up permits. Permits are required for new reads to start; and the database will evict paused reads (if any) to be able to admit new ones; if there is a shortage of permits.

metrics.name: scylla.database.querier_cache_drops
metrics.description: Counts querier cache lookups that found a cached querier but had to drop it due to position mismatch

metrics.name: scylla.database.querier_cache_lookups
metrics.description: Counts querier cache lookups (paging queries)

metrics.name: scylla.database.querier_cache_memory_based_evictions
metrics.description: Counts querier cache entries that were evicted because the memory usage of the cached queriers were above the limit.

metrics.name: scylla.database.querier_cache_misses
metrics.description: Counts querier cache lookups that failed to find a cached querier

metrics.name: scylla.database.querier_cache_population
metrics.description: The number of entries currently in the querier cache.

metrics.name: scylla.database.querier_cache_resource_based_evictions
metrics.description: Counts querier cache entries that were evicted to free up resources (limited by reader concurrency limits) necessary to create new readers.

metrics.name: scylla.database.querier_cache_time_based_evictions
metrics.description: Counts querier cache entries that timed out and were evicted.

metrics.name: scylla.database.queued_reads
metrics.description: Holds the number of currently queued read operations.

metrics.name: scylla.database.reads_shed_due_to_overload
metrics.description: The number of reads shed because the admission queue reached its max capacity. When the queue is full, excessive reads are shed to avoid overload.

metrics.name: scylla.database.requests_blocked_memory
metrics.description: Holds the number of requests blocked due to reaching the memory quota (27839692B). Non-zero value indicates that our bottleneck is memory and more specifically - the memory quota allocated for the "database" component.

metrics.name: scylla.database.requests_blocked_memory_current
metrics.description: Holds the current number of requests blocked due to reaching the memory quota (27839692B). Non-zero value indicates that our bottleneck is memory and more specifically - the memory quota allocated for the "database" component.

metrics.name: scylla.database.schema_changed
metrics.description: The number of times the schema changed

metrics.name: scylla.database.short_data_queries
metrics.description: The rate of data queries (data or digest reads) that returned less rows than requested due to result size limiting.

metrics.name: scylla.database.short_mutation_queries
metrics.description: The rate of mutation queries that returned less rows than requested due to result size limiting.

metrics.name: scylla.database.sstable_read_queue_overloads
metrics.description: Counts the number of times the sstable read queue was overloaded. A non-zero value indicates that we have to drop read requests because they arrive faster than we can serve them.

metrics.name: scylla.database.sstables_read
metrics.description: Holds the number of currently read sstables.

metrics.name: scylla.database.total_reads
metrics.description: Counts the total number of successful reads on this shard.

metrics.name: scylla.database.total_reads_failed
metrics.description: Counts the total number of failed read operations. Add the total_reads to this value to get the total amount of reads issued on this shard.

metrics.name: scylla.database.total_reads_rate_limited
metrics.description: Counts read operations which were rejected on the replica side because the per-partition limit was reached.

metrics.name: scylla.database.total_result_bytes
metrics.description: Holds the current amount of memory used for results.

metrics.name: scylla.database.total_view_updates_failed_local

metrics.name: scylla.database.total_view_updates_failed_remote

metrics.name: scylla.database.total_view_updates_pushed_local
metrics.description: Total number of view updates generated for tables and applied locally.

metrics.name: scylla.database.total_view_updates_pushed_remote
metrics.description: Total number of view updates generated for tables and sent to remote replicas.

metrics.description: Counts the total number of successful write operations performed by this shard.

metrics.name: scylla.database.total_writes_failed
metrics.description: Counts the total number of failed write operations. A sum of this value plus total_writes represents a total amount of writes attempted on this shard.

metrics.name: scylla.database.total_writes_rate_limited
metrics.description: Counts write operations which were rejected on the replica side because the per-partition limit was reached.

metrics.name: scylla.database.total_writes_timedout

metrics.description: number of remote data read requests this Node received

metrics.name: scylla.storage.proxy.replica_received_counter_updates
metrics.description: number of counter updates received by this node acting as an update leader

metrics.name: scylla.storage.proxy.replica_received_mutations
metrics.description: number of mutations received by a replica Node

metrics.name: scylla.streaming.finished_percentage
metrics.description: Finished percentage of node operation on this shard

metrics.name: scylla.streaming.total_incoming_bytes
metrics.description: Total number of bytes received on this shard.

metrics.name: scylla.streaming.total_outgoing_bytes
metrics.description: Total number of bytes sent on this shard.

metrics.name: scylla.thrift.current_connections
metrics.description: Holds a current number of opened Thrift connections.

metrics.name: scylla.thrift.served
metrics.description: Rate of serving Thrift requests.

metrics.name: scylla.thrift.thrift_connections
metrics.description: Rate of creation of new Thrift connections.

metrics.name: scylla.tracing.active_sessions
metrics.description: Holds a number of a currently active tracing sessions.

metrics.name: scylla.tracing.cached_records
metrics.description: Holds a number of tracing records cached in the tracing sessions that are not going to be written in the next write event. If sum of this metric; pending_for_write_records and flushing_records is close to 11000 we are likely to start dropping tracing records.

metrics.name: scylla.tracing.dropped_records
metrics.description: Counts a number of dropped records due to too many pending records. High value indicates that backend is saturated with the rate with which new tracing records are created.

metrics.name: scylla.tracing.dropped_sessions
metrics.description: Counts a number of dropped sessions due to too many pending sessions/records. High value indicates that backend is saturated with the rate with which new tracing records are created.

metrics.name: scylla.tracing.flushing_records
metrics.description: Holds a number of tracing records that currently being written to the I/O backend. If sum of this metric; cached_records and pending_for_write_records is close to 11000 we are likely to start dropping tracing records.

metrics.name: scylla.tracing.keyspace_helper_bad_column_family_errors
metrics.description: Counts a number of times write failed due to one of the tables in the system_traces keyspace has an incompatible schema. One error may result one or more tracing records to be lost. Non-zero value indicates that the administrator has to take immediate steps to fix the corresponding schema. The appropriate error message will be printed in the syslog.

metrics.name: scylla.tracing.keyspace_helper_tracing_errors
metrics.description: Counts a number of errors during writing to a system_traces keyspace. One error may cause one or more tracing records to be lost.

metrics.name: scylla.tracing.pending_for_write_records
metrics.description: Holds a number of tracing records that are going to be written in the next write event. If sum of this metric; cached_records and flushing_records is close to 11000 we are likely to start dropping tracing records.

metrics.name: scylla.tracing.trace_errors
metrics.description: Counts a number of trace records dropped due to an error (e.g. OOM).

metrics.name: scylla.tracing.trace_records_count
metrics.description: This metric is a rate of tracing records generation.

metrics.name: scylla.transport.auth_responses
metrics.description: Counts the total number of received CQL AUTH messages.

metrics.name: scylla.transport.batch_requests
metrics.description: Counts the total number of received CQL BATCH messages.

metrics.name: scylla.transport.cql_connections
metrics.description: Counts a number of client connections.

metrics.name: scylla.transport.cql_errors_total
metrics.description: Counts the total number of returned CQL errors.

metrics.name: scylla.transport.current_connections
metrics.description: Holds a current number of client connections.

metrics.name: scylla.transport.execute_requests
metrics.description: Counts the total number of received CQL EXECUTE messages.

metrics.name: scylla.transport.options_requests
metrics.description: Counts the total number of received CQL OPTIONS messages.

metrics.name: scylla.transport.prepare_requests
metrics.description: Counts the total number of received CQL PREPARE messages.

metrics.name: scylla.transport.query_requests
metrics.description: Counts the total number of received CQL QUERY messages.

metrics.name: scylla.transport.register_requests
metrics.description: Counts the total number of received CQL REGISTER messages.

metrics.name: scylla.transport.requests_blocked_memory
metrics.description: Holds an incrementing counter with the requests that ever blocked due to reaching the memory quota limit (12373196B). The first derivative of this value shows how often we block due to memory exhaustion in the "CQL transport" component.

metrics.name: scylla.transport.requests_blocked_memory_current
metrics.description: Holds the number of requests that are currently blocked due to reaching the memory quota limit (12373196B). Non-zero value indicates that our bottleneck is memory and more specifically - the memory quota allocated for the "CQL transport" component.

metrics.name: scylla.transport.requests_memory_available
metrics.description: Holds the amount of available memory for admitting new requests (max is 219571814B).Zero value indicates that our bottleneck is memory and more specifically - the memory quota allocated for the CQL transport component.

metrics.name: scylla.transport.requests_served
metrics.description: Counts a number of served requests.

metrics.name: scylla.transport.requests_serving
metrics.description: Holds a number of requests that are being processed right now.

metrics.name: scylla.transport.requests_shed
metrics.description: Holds an incrementing counter with the requests that were shed due to overload (threshold configured via max_concurrent_requests_per_shard). The first derivative of this value shows how often we shed requests due to overload in the CQL transport component.

metrics.name: scylla.transport.startups
metrics.description: Counts the total number of received CQL STARTUP messages.

metrics.name: scylla.view.builder_builds_in_progress
metrics.description: Number of currently active view builds.

metrics.name: scylla.view.builder_pending_bookkeeping_ops
metrics.description: Number of tasks waiting to perform bookkeeping operations

metrics.name: scylla.view.builder_steps_failed
metrics.description: Number of failed build steps.

metrics.name: scylla.view.builder_steps_performed
metrics.description: Number of performed build steps.

metrics.name: scylla.view.update_generator_pending_registrations
metrics.description: Number of tasks waiting to register staging sstables

metrics.name: scylla.view.update_generator_queued_batches_count
metrics.description: Number of sets of sstables queued for view update generation

metrics.name: scylla.view.update_generator_sstables_pending_work
metrics.description: Number of bytes remaining to be processed from SSTables for view updates

metrics.name: scylla.view.update_generator_sstables_to_move_count
metrics.description: Number of sets of sstables which are already processed and wait to be moved from their staging directory

serviceChecks.name: Scylla prometheus health
serviceChecks.description: Returns `CRITICAL` if the check cannot access the metrics endpoint. Returns `OK` otherwise.

serviceChecks.name: Scylla openmetrics endpoint up
serviceChecks.description: Returns `CRITICAL` if the check cannot access the Prometheus metrics endpoint of the Gitlab instance.

monitors.title: Node State is abnormal
monitors.description: A Scylla server "shutting down" typically indicates a planned maintenance, upgrade, or scaling operation. The monitor tracks if your Scylla node change states.

releaseNotes.notes:
***Added***:

* Add container-based config discovery support. ([#24498](https://github.com/DataDog/integrations-core/pull/24498))

***Fixed***:

* Require `datadog-checks-base>=37.41.0` since config discovery relies on it. ([#24545](https://github.com/DataDog/integrations-core/pull/24545))

***Added***:

* Add support for security validation in models ([#23109](https://github.com/DataDog/integrations-core/pull/23109))

***Added***:

* Add `enable_legacy_tags_normalization` option to preserve hyphens in tag values when set to false. ([#22303](https://github.com/DataDog/integrations-core/pull/22303))

***Added***:

* Bump minimum version of datadog-checks-base to 37.24.0 ([#21945](https://github.com/DataDog/integrations-core/pull/21945))

***Fixed***:

* Add allowed values list on kerberos_auth field ([#20879](https://github.com/DataDog/integrations-core/pull/20879))
* Fix schema issue on `ignore_metrics_by_labels` field ([#21583](https://github.com/DataDog/integrations-core/pull/21583))

***Added***:

* Bump Python to 3.13 ([#21161](https://github.com/DataDog/integrations-core/pull/21161))
* Bump datadog-checks-base to 37.21.0 ([#21477](https://github.com/DataDog/integrations-core/pull/21477))

***Fixed***:

* Improve descriptions and examples in example configuration file ([#20878](https://github.com/DataDog/integrations-core/pull/20878))

***Removed***:

* Remove support for Python 2. ([#18580](https://github.com/DataDog/integrations-core/pull/18580))

***Fixed***:

* Bump the version of datadog-checks-base to 37.0.0 ([#18617](https://github.com/DataDog/integrations-core/pull/18617))

***Changed***:

* Bump minimum version of base check ([#18733](https://github.com/DataDog/integrations-core/pull/18733))

***Added***:

* Bump the python version from 3.11 to 3.12 ([#18212](https://github.com/DataDog/integrations-core/pull/18212))

***Fixed***:

* Update the description for the `tls_ca_cert` config option to use `openssl rehash` instead of `c_rehash` ([#16981](https://github.com/DataDog/integrations-core/pull/16981))

***Added***:

* Add OMv2 support to Scylla integration ([#16497](https://github.com/DataDog/integrations-core/pull/16497))
* Update the configuration file to include the new oauth options parameter ([#16835](https://github.com/DataDog/integrations-core/pull/16835))
